description: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5 Omni (text, image, video and audio input) as lukealonso's ModelOpt NVFP4 checkpoint on two Sparks with vLLM tensor parallel 2 over Ray, a 744,192-token context (creator profile 1M) on a 4-bit NVFP4 KV cache (DiffKV Triton backend with WMMA decode) and safetensors loading; MTP1 speculative decoding (the upstream default) is an option and is off by default here. Basis: tonyd2wild's recipe (MIT; the vendored mods are derived from vLLM, Apache-2.0) on tonyd2wild's published patched vLLM 0.21.1rc1.dev85 dev-build image, with upstream's four image mods applied at build time. Alternatives by the same creator for this model and Spark count are the DFlash speculative-decoding variants with FP8 or NVFP4 KV (separate repositories, not packaged here). Upstream figures (about 32 tok/s single stream, 184 tok/s at eight streams, 2.17M-token KV pool at 1M context) are claims until measured here; the upstream deployment is Ray-based and Vonk physical two-Spark acceptance is pending. Sampling defaults is chosen per request (chat template kwargs or sampling parameters), not as a recipe option; server default: temperature 0, top_p 0.95, repetition_penalty 1.08 (upstream default). GB10 fit: the declared peak is the loading floor (selected weights, this KV pool and 8 GB runtime overhead) and the 0.759290 startup budget stays inside it. Absolute KV correction: 7,463,577,600 bytes per rank covers 3 simultaneous full-context requests at 744,192 tokens using the pinned cache-geometry allocation bound. Context stays capped at 744,192 tokens (creator profile 1,000,000). Speculative decoding is off by default so a start needs neither the MTP drafter's weights nor its second pass over the whole checkpoint: both hardware starts were stopped by the host memory guard on the entrypoint before any KV cache existed, on 2026-10-27 at the end of the target weight load (6.6 GB available, before the drafter) and on 2026-10-25 about three minutes after the target's post-load processing (2.3 GB available). Off does not change the target load, so a start can still be stopped in that first window; upstream runs a root page-cache drop loop during bring-up that Vonk does not run. This is an offline estimate; physical acceptance remains pending.
title: MiMo V2.5 Omni NVFP4 vLLM two Sparks
